newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: SM Prime taps NZ firm for aquarium.
newsitem.headline: SM Prime taps NZ firm for aquarium.

text.p: Mall builder SM Prime Holdings Inc said on Thursday it had signed a memorandum of agreement with Richina Underwater Holdings Ltd of New Zealand to build an underwater aquarium in one of its proposed shopping malls.
Richina will design, construct, and operate an aquarium in the soon-to-be-built Mall of Asia in Manila.
Specific terms will be negotiated and finalised on or before the end of March next year, SM Prime said in a statement.
"The project is geared towards both the local market and the anticipated tourism boom in Asia in which the Philippines expects to get its fair share," it added.
